wire.envelope: Keep existing BridgeFrame keys. Versioned pause payload inside payload; path points only to known sandbox output filename, not arbitrary host path.
wire.control: Bound command.pause request within command channel; require capability negotiation and initialized project/session/task/run/epoch/generation/dispatch/manifest/process identity
wire.payload_limit: Preserve 64 KiB line limit. Checkpoint <= accepted SDK 12 MiB via regular no-reparse sandbox file; host reads bounded bytes once, copies to trusted store, seals exact bytes. Recovery metadata keeps pointer/hash; update reader bounds synchronously, not sender-only.
wire.sequence: All worker frames use one existing emit counter: checkpoint at s, turn.paused at s+1 (or later strictly next after other frames). ACK correlates checkpoint s/hash/artifact-use receipt. New epoch starts its own frame sequence with new process/dispatch binding; old ACK/frame rejected.
wire.ack: Only checkpoint.sealed after durable bytes, CHECKPOINT Artifact/use binding and journal persistence qualifies. persisted=true alone never enough.
wire.resume: Core validates old checkpoint original epoch and immutable content; separate activation envelope links e->e+1 and carry receipt. SDK restore verifies original leaseEpoch/inputHash, then resumes under new outer activation. Never edit checkpoint JSON to relabel epoch.

states.pause_intent: Authenticate/authorize/CAS transaction records PAUSE_REQUESTED tied to Task/Run/e; Task BLOCKED is intent only, cancel_requested_at untouched; Gate stops new model/tool/control deliveries while current effects drain.
states.pause_confirm: CHECKPOINT_SEALED -> PAUSED_CONFIRMED only after matched ACK, worker terminal paused, actual old process tree and all streams closed, effects reconciled, queues snapshotted, consumption receipts reconciled. No public Run.status=PAUSED.
states.canonical: Keep existing nonterminal Run enum and original active_run_id; internal pause ledger is authoritative execution gate. Paused-safe Run is excluded from timeout reconciliation and automatic claim; pending/unconfirmed timeout remains RECONCILING. No failure counter reset or fake queue_empty=true.
states.resume: Current authorized RESUME takes PAUSED_CONFIRMED to RESUME_PREPARED with CAS, atomically same Run e+1/new lease/new dispatch/new activation/carry lineage/Task RUNNING; Goal remains ACTIVE in first Task-only slice. launch proves ACTIVE then record RESUMED. Duplicate same request returns same result; concurrent different resume loses CAS.
states.cancellation: CANCEL always dominates intent/paused/resume race. Never reuse CANCELLED Run; later explicit user continuation uses new attempt/Run with origin checkpoint. First card rejects CANCELLED-as-resume, does not implement all cancel-followup UX.

queue.generation: Keep same generation, command_id, message_id, content_hash, queue_sequence; execution epoch differs from writer_epoch. Do not rotate writer epoch to resume.

states.ENQUEUED: Not in checkpoint: send once after new activation gated/authorized.
states.SDK_ACCEPTED: Present in frozen SDK queues or snapshot consumed watermarks; restore exactly once, do not redeliver from durable queue.
states.CONSUMED: Never send again; retain receipt chain/watermark.
states.SENDING_UNKNOWN: Resolve from durable acceptance/consumption receipts + snapshot; if ambiguous stay UNKNOWN/RECONCILING, never blind retry.

queue.worker_state: Checkpoint envelope includes protocol cumulative model/tool counts, accepted command ledger and SDK consumption watermarks/mapping, so max_calls and budget liabilities do not reset. SDK stream state is completed/drained; no in-flight request replay.
queue.fence: Additional pause/activation gate preserves original OPEN fence meaning, blocks delivery while paused; bindClientRunQueue cannot simply relax runtime_epoch equality. Only CAS-certified successor activation may update current pointer and its associated fence epoch; prior activation immutable.
queue.arrivals: New allowed user commands while paused remain ENQUEUED above captured cut; never injected into frozen snapshot retroactively. Uncertain control/consume races require reconcile first.

Through actual local product session/task creation + sole coordinator, run a bounded task in a throwaway workspace with a registered tool/check. Observe one real in-flight tool, enqueue identifiable STEER and FOLLOW_UP through product APIs, persist accepted identity/receipts.

Call V1 Task PAUSE with current If-Match/idempotency/auth. Observe intent while tool is draining. Complete the actual bounded tool safely; the next model/tool effect must not dispatch. Wait for checkpoint seal ACK, turn.paused, old process+streams stopped and PAUSED_CONFIRMED.

Read frozen checkpoint and canonical ledgers: original product and SDK session/tree/leaf, exact two queues/consumption map, known completed effect once, prior budget liability unchanged, Task BLOCKED but no CANCEL marker and no invented Run enum.

Call explicit current-authority V1 RESUME. In one transaction same run id gets e+1 and one new dispatch/activation; restore old snapshot with original binding and separately validated carry; do not call prompt(original) again.

Observe new real process identity, same model config/input, queues consumed once and order preserved, final assistant response and no errors, effect counts/receipts consistent. Replay RESUME then revoke device and retry old successful request: no additional execution and revoked replay denied.

Seal native/LIVE/model/queue evidence separately; repeat deterministic loss/corruption/cancel cases in fixture before LIVE. Phone viewport screenshots and source passes do not satisfy phone A10/A11/C17.
